title: Category lockup tour with flipping cards
summary: A fixed wordmark gains one category word per section: a chip grows into full-bleed footage, a cover wall pushes in, puzzle cards flip off a stack, photos swing flat from tilted planes. Ends on a light statement and the bare mark.
use_when: A bundle or subscription with 4-6 distinct content categories to name one by one
The brand mark is short enough to sit beside a swapped category word
You have strong full-bleed photos or footage per category plus a few UI cards
A calm, premium, silent-autoplay brand film of about 30 s

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, about 5 % of frame height; lockup words in white over footage, near-black on light grey

sfx.event: chip check mark lands inside the phrase
tilted photo plane or card swings flat to full frame
puzzle card flips down off the stack
final suffix appears on the wordmark

structure.shot: wordmark centred on light grey; a column of 6 category words rolls up beside it; then a 3-word phrase with a chip slot
structure.camera: drift 1.00->1.02 (wordmark recentres left as the column appears)
structure.motion: category words roll upward one per ~0.15 s, fading top and bottom, easings.inOutSine 30 fr (±0.25 s); phrase replaces lockup at 1.50; dark chip with a check grows between two words, springs.ui 12 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: the chip opens into a rounded window of ocean footage that fills the frame; white lockup: mark + first category word
structure.motion: chip window scales to full bleed in ~6 fr, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s), extra hard cut at 2.73 inside the growth; category word wipes in left to right in ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: footage shrinks into one magazine-cover card; a row of 4 covers centred on light grey
structure.camera: static row, then lateral travel left from 4.50
structure.motion: frame shrinks into the 4th cover, springs.layout 11 fr; row slides left and new covers enter from right and below, stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a three-row wall of covers fills the frame; a 2-word count statement sits in a gap mid row
structure.motion: cover rows drift horizontally in opposite directions ~1 px/fr; count word types on letter by letter in ~8 fr (±0.25 s); push easings.inExpo 28 fr

structure.shot: a yellow card swings up from a tilted plane to fill the frame; white lockup: mark + second category word, an animated emoji over the gap
structure.motion: card rotates from ~60° tilt to flat, springs.heavy 20 fr (overshoot not measurable); category word wipes in behind the emoji ~8 fr; emoji cycles 3 expressions every ~8 fr

structure.shot: first puzzle card (word game UI) rises on a stand of the previous yellow card, centred on light grey
structure.motion: card rises from the bottom edge, springs.ui 10 fr; at 9.50 top card flips down toward camera revealing the next card, easings.inExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: card flip chain: three more puzzle cards in purple, orange, green, each flipping down to reveal the next
structure.motion: one flip every ~0.5 s (15 fr); each top card hinges at its bottom edge and falls to become the base of the next, easings.inExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: fifth puzzle card in blue lands and holds, the base drops away
structure.motion: base sinks out 10 fr; hold ~1.2 s; card rotates on Y ~25° and shrinks, easings.inExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: food photo on a tilted plane swings flat to full frame; white lockup: mark + third category word
structure.motion: plane flattens springs.heavy 9 fr (±0.25 s); category word wipes in left to right ~8 fr

structure.shot: a stack of 4 recipe cards slides down from the top as the photo leaves at the bottom; stack scrolls up
structure.motion: photo pushed down and out 12 fr easings.inOutSine; cards enter staggered 3 fr from the top, then the stack scrolls up, front cards leave at the top

structure.shot: wildlife photo on a tilted plane swings flat to full frame; white lockup: mark + fourth category word
structure.motion: plane flattens springs.heavy 9 fr (±0.25 s); category word wipes in ~8 fr; lockup dissolves out 8 fr before the cut

structure.shot: mid-blue field: a news card (headline + photo) slides out left; then a 1-word lead-in with a rolling column of 7 place names ending in a summary phrase
structure.motion: card holds 1.1 s then slides left 8 fr easings.inExpo; place column enters from right 8 fr, rolls up one name per ~4 fr, easings.inOutSine, settles on the summary line at 21.00; text drifts up and fades 8 fr

structure.shot: low-angle portrait footage; white lockup: mark + fifth category word
structure.camera: drift up: lockup rises ~150 px @1920 over 15 fr, then holds
structure.motion: lockup slides up with the footage, springs.ui 12 fr; category word holds

structure.shot: footage shrinks into a rounded card at frame left; a 3-word phrase appears to its right on light grey
structure.motion: frame shrinks springs.layout 12 fr (±0.25 s); phrase wipes in left to right 8 fr; card and phrase slide out left from 24.27 easings.inExpo 8 fr

structure.shot: 6 small article cards drift right to left on a diagonal; a 3-word phrase slides in from the right and settles centre
structure.motion: cards cross the frame in ~1 s each, stagger ~6 fr, easings.linear; phrase enters from right springs.ui 12 fr

structure.shot: a phone with the app home screen rises from the bottom, crosses the frame and exits at the top
structure.motion: phone rises springs.heavy 15 fr to centre, holds 8 fr, continues up and out easings.inExpo 12 fr; phrase pushed up by the phone

structure.shot: closing 4-word statement centred on light grey
structure.motion: statement fades in 6 fr easings.outQuint (±0.25 s), holds ~0.8 s, fades out 4 fr

structure.shot: the bare wordmark centred; the suffix symbol appears after 0.5 s and the lockup recentres
structure.motion: wordmark cut in; suffix pops in at 29.27, springs.snappy 8 fr (overshoot not measurable); lockup shifts to stay centred springs.ui 8 fr; hold 0.9 s to end

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, bg (light grey), accent; wordmark from brand.logo
params.content.categories: 5 category words, one per section, each 1 word; a 6th optional for the opening roll
params.content.footage: 5 full-bleed photos or clips, one per category (2 of them used inside tilted planes)
params.content.covers: 12-16 portrait cover images for the wall
params.content.count: count statement for the wall, 2 words with a number
params.content.cards: 5 square UI cards for the flip chain, each with its own flat colour
params.content.stackCards: 4 small horizontal cards for the scrolling stack
params.content.places: lead-in word + 5-8 list items + a summary line for the roll
params.content.phrases: 3 short lines: chip phrase (3 words), two closing phrases (3-4 words)
params.content.phoneScreen: one app home screenshot for the phone
params.content.suffix: symbol or short word added to the wordmark at the end ('' = none)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); no source strips. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. The constant is the lockup: mark fixed at left of centre, one category word wiped in to its right over each full-bleed photo. Every section enters through a shape change (chip opens, frame shrinks to card, tilted plane swings flat, card flips) rather than a cut. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): card-flip-chain, chip-window-expand, word-clip-wipe.
